searchText: ```python from sage.structure.proof.all import arithmetic arithmetic(False) # use probabilistic proofs to accelerate compute curve_config = { 'BN254' : { 'p': Integer('0x30644e72e131a029b85045b68181585d97816a916871ca8d3c208c16d87cfd47'), 'b': 3 }, 'BLS12_377' : { 'p': Integer('0x01ae3a4617c510eac63b05c06ca1493b1a22d9f300f5138f1ef3622fba094800170b5d44300000008508c00000000001'), 'b': 1 } } def get2torsion(curve_name): p = curve_config[curve_name]['p'] b = curve_config[curve_name]['b'] Fp = GF(p) G1 = EllipticCurve(Fp, [0, b]) P = G1(0) print(P.division_points(2)) if __name__ == "__main__": get2torsion('BN254') get2torsion('BLS12_377') ``` BN254 doesn't have any, BLS12_377 has some.
